conflicts.summary: Heating/cooling inferred as both ducted and split from generic reverse-cycle wording, then reported as a document conflict.
conflicts.basis: The drawings require reverse-cycle at minimum 3-star but select neither system. The engine reported a conflict between two of its own inferences, which is the unsupported-model-inference class.

conflicts.summary: Roof pitch prints as both 2 degrees and 59 degrees.
conflicts.basis: OVERRIDES THE AUDIT. The auditor dismissed this as different roof planes. Reading page 6, the 59-degree note and the 2-degree notes annotate planes of the same building, the figure is anomalous against a flat parapet-and-box-gutter design with 3-degree capping falls, and it sits half under the permit stamp. It is a genuine document anomaly needing designer confirmation.

conflicts.summary: A timber deck or balcony asserted from a perspective render.
conflicts.basis: Page 21 shows no deck in any of its six renders. Not a misread render: content asserted that the cited page does not contain.

conflicts.summary: Solar labelled 2.5 kW while the same note specifies 8 panels at 330 W, which is 2.64 kW.
conflicts.basis: Printed twice on page 6. A deterministic arithmetic identity the engine missed entirely, and the reason arithmetic must not be left to a language model.

conflicts.summary: Sanitary exhaust requires 35 L/s where there is no window, while the NCC exhaust table on the same set specifies 25 L/s.
conflicts.basis: Real printed contradiction across pp.4-5/18-19 against p.15. Missed by the engine and by the audit's own conflict list.

regressions.rationale: Generic reverse-cycle wording became a ducted-versus-split contradiction.

regressions.title: Arithmetic identities are checked deterministically
regressions.rationale: 8 x 330 W = 2.64 kW against a printed 2.5 kW label.

regressions.title: Conditional items do not gap without an activation signal
regressions.rationale: Flyscreens, outdoor kitchen, shaving cabinets, pool and lift were gapped from possibility. 'Fly screen' appears in the set exactly once, describing a rainwater-tank strainer.

regressions.title: An explicit N/A suppresses the item
regressions.rationale: Page 1 records 'BAL Level : N/A'; the engine raised a bushfire-compliance gap.

regressions.title: Preliminaries are contractor obligations, never design gaps
regressions.rationale: Thirteen preliminaries lines were presented to the owner as missing documents. No drawing has ever shown scaffolding.

regressions.title: A referenced-but-unsupplied package is a dependency, not a design commission
regressions.rationale: The set repeatedly refers slab, bracing and lintels to engineering. The owner must be told to obtain the package, not to commission a new design.

regressions.title: Precise dimensions do not make a line priceable
regressions.rationale: Wall framing schedules stud sizes and spacings while bracing and lintels remain 'refer engineering'; box gutters give minimum dimensions while sump and overflow sizing is left to AS/NZS 3500.3.

notes: The sparse pole of the corpus: one architectural set, no consultant packages. Tests whether silence is judged against WHAT WAS SUPPLIED rather than against an idealised full pack. Labels derive from the independent verification, except where our own read of the drawings overturned it (source: adjudicated) — the roof-pitch conflict, sub-soil drainage, steel, and the deck. Rows the auditor's wording left ambiguous carry reviewerConfirmation: required and are excluded from metrics until ratified.
